reportTemplate.summary: On {{v1}} I deleted both parts via each row's Delete action; each opened a custom "Confirm" dialog which I accepted with its "Delete part" button. After the first delete the total dropped from $437.50 to $250.00, and after the second the parts table read only its header plus "No parts on this ticket yet." (the table's total row disappears entirely when empty, so no "$0.00" is shown anywhere). I then clicked "Archive ticket" on the detail page — no confirmation dialog appeared — and the page changed: Status now reads "{{v2}}" with an added "Archived" badge and the button became "Unarchive ticket". On the tickets list {{v1}} is absent from the active list (still showing 13 rows, top row RD-1014) and appears as the first row only once "Show archived" is checked: "{{v1}} {{v4}} RD Bench Ticket Archived Bench Works Ltd {{v2}} 0 2026-09-23". The only confirmation for archiving was that "Archived" badge/button swap — I found no confirmation message text or native dialog.
